name: ch9_selected_pcc27_gq125
title: ch9_selected_pcc27 with the STS interface weight g_q raised x1.25 for DSO_1-3
description: Identical to ch9_selected_pcc27 (g_w_pcc = 27 x g_w_der, shunt_int_g_w 0.06)
plus a per-area interface-Q weight g_q = 1.25 x 0.4977 = 0.6221 for DSO_1,
DSO_2 and DSO_3; DSO_4 keeps the global g_q = 0.4977.
Counterpart of ch9_selected_pcc27_gqceil with contraction margin kept: at
x1.25 the worst STS lambda_max(B) of DSO_1/2/3 is 1.249 / 1.343 / 1.201,
below the binding TS row (1.357), so the overall certificate of
ch9_selected_pcc27 is unchanged (select ceiling 1.546; per-area ceilings
ranked windows W1-W4, W6, 12 h, DSO_3 x2: e_v(TS) 0.00129, e_v(DS) 0.00539
(+2.5 % vs pcc27), e_q 122 119 (-9 % vs pcc27), recruited flow 15.7 Mvar
per STS median, no corridor violations, DSO taps worst 6 /d.
NOT part of the Chapter-9 parameter space, which carries one global g_q.
